name: Robert E. Lee
desc: Commander of the Army of Northern Virginia. On June 30, 1863, Lee was near Cashtown concentrating Confederate forces before the unexpected meeting engagement at Gettysburg.

name: Henry Heth
desc: Confederate division commander ordered toward Gettysburg on July 1. His movement initiated the fighting that developed into the Battle of Gettysburg.

name: John Buford
desc: Union cavalry commander who recognized the importance of the high ground south of Gettysburg and deployed his troopers west of town to delay Confederate advances.

name: John Reynolds
desc: Commander of Union I Corps. Reynolds was moving toward Gettysburg to support Buford's cavalry and would arrive during the battle's opening hours.
